description: The verbatim record of one chamber sitting (GET /v1/floor-transcripts/{transcript_id}): debate, explanations of vote and roll calls as spoken on the floor. A sitting can run to 850,000 characters, so this returns a window (offset, max_chars, next_offset) or, with search, every passage that mentions a phrase such as a bill number or a member's name. Get transcript_id from list_floor_transcripts.

max_chars.description: How many transcript characters to return (default 30000, max 60000).

offset.description: Character offset to start reading the transcript from (default 0). Use next_offset to continue.

search.description: Instead of a window, return every passage that mentions this phrase (case-insensitive, up to 20), each with its offset. Use it to find what a member said about a topic or bill.

name: get_floor_transcript
title: Read one floor-session transcript
